text_block_list.text:
Since Yaeno Muteki wasn't feeling well, I 
decided to take her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry. I will make sure to rest 
properly so as not to cause you further 
worry...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Gh!? Where... is this...!?

text_block_list.name: Karasu Tengu
text_block_list.text: —Have you noticed, young seeker?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Wha--!? A tengu...!?

text_block_list.name: Karasu Tengu
text_block_list.text:
Being guided here... does that mean you 
have the resolve to undergo my training?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I... I have heard of this. Since ancient 
times, warriors who trained under tengu 
spread their martial renown across the 
realm...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"—By all means! I humbly request it of 
you!"

text_block_list.name: Karasu Tengu
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Then first, you'll have to keep up 
with me! If your body can manage to cling 
on, that is!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Absurd! Even if I am plagued by ill 
health... If it is to attain the ultimate 
secret, I will pursue it across a thousand 
miles...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! Is it over already...?!

text_block_list.name: Karasu Tengu
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent, Yaeno Muteki! Fufu…… Does it 
not seem as though you no longer feel even 
a hint of your slump?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Gasp!? Y-You're right... Partway through, 
I was just lost in the moment, sprinting 
with all my might...!

text_block_list.name: Karasu Tengu
text_block_list.text:
"You have nothing left to worry about. 
Now, return to your own world!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Lord Tengu. Thank you very much for 
your guidance!"

Perhaps having had a good dream, Yaeno 
Muteki showed no signs of being unwell, 
looking completely lively and energetic.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Nghhh...! What incredible speed! At my 
current level, I could never catch up...!

text_block_list.name: Karasu Tengu
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Yaeno Muteki, still so immature!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Gasp?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
What a disgrace...! To fail to complete my 
training, even in a dream...!

Despite taking a rest, Yaeno Muteki still 
seems to be feeling under the weather...
